final: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS c FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT link_to_major, c, c * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(c) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.c) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
